userdoc.notice: This is a sample contract to be used in the BasedDistributorV2 contract for partners to reward stakers with their native token alongside ALB. It assumes no minting rights, so requires a set amount of YOUR_TOKEN to be transferred to this contract prior. E.g. say you've allocated 100,000 XYZ to the ALB-XYZ farm over 30 days. Then you would need to transfer 100,000 XYZ and set the block reward accordingly so it's fully distributed after 30 days.
